usage: 電源 is used to refer to the source of electrical power.
It can describe a physical plug, socket, or any device supplying electricity.
You often use 電源 when talking about turning devices on or off.
It can also mean the concept of power supply in technical or daily contexts.
電源 can be used in both formal and casual speech.
